name: cpp-mod-mgr
usage-1: cpp-mod-mgr config: Check the configuration (This isn't yet implemented)
usage-2: cpp-mod-mgr cmake <output_file.cmake>: Generate CMake configuration file using modules & a custom compiler
usage-3: cpp-mod-mgr build: populate the Built Module Intermediate cache with the std and std.compat modules

scripts.fmt: tools format bun && bun run cfmt
scripts.dcfg: bun run mod_cmake && cd testing && cmake --preset debug
scripts.rcfg: bun run mod_cmake && cd testing && cmake --preset release
scripts.cfg: bun run dcfg && bun run rcfg
scripts.dcpp: bun run mod_bld && cd testing && cmake --build build/Debug
scripts.rcpp: bun run mod_bld && cd testing && cmake --build build/Release
scripts.cpp: bun run dcpp && bun run rcpp
scripts.dtst: bun run dcfg && bun run dcpp && cd testing/build/Debug && ctest --output-on-failure
scripts.rtst: bun run rcfg && bun run rcpp && cd testing/build/Release && ctest
scripts.tst: bun run dtst && bun run rtst
scripts.run: bun run drun && bun run rrun
